objective: Check whether the November BTCPay Server thefts can support a held-out evaluation of pooled Coldcard and CryptoBilis training.
unit: Bitcoin input address with a documented reference payment to the reported collector.
target: Membership in the documented source cohort.
pilot_scope: The published direct sweep below. Audit the address witnesses visible in its transaction record.
grouping: All inputs of the reference transaction share one observed component. Merchant identity and links to other sweeps remain unresolved.
cutoff: Use only confirmed transactions in blocks strictly below the reference block for any future feature extraction.
test_design: Hold the whole incident out. Audit address and transaction links to the two development cohorts before selecting comparison sources from the same reference blocks.
